tools.name: charliehr_get_company
tools.description: The Charlie company the API keys belong to: id, name, subdomain and logo. GET /company.

tools.name: charliehr_list_offices
tools.description: List the company's offices: id, name, whether it is the head office, address, timezone, phone and email. GET /offices.

tools.name: charliehr_get_office
tools.description: One office by id. GET /offices/{id}.

tools.name: charliehr_list_teams
tools.description: List the company's teams with the ids of their team members. GET /teams.

tools.name: charliehr_get_team
tools.description: One team by id, with the ids of its team members. GET /teams/{id}.

tools.name: charliehr_list_team_members
tools.description: List the company's team members (employees): name, work and personal email, phone, address, office, manager, teams, job title, start date, employment status and leaving date. Sensitive fields included: date_of_birth, gender, married, personal email, phone and home address. National Insurance numbers

tools.name: charliehr_get_team_member
tools.description: One team member by id with the full profile (contact details, address, office, manager, teams, dates, employment status, job title, notes). Sensitive fields included: date_of_birth, gender, married, personal email, phone, home address and notes. National Insurance numbers (also inside notes), payrol

tools.name: charliehr_get_team_member_working_location
tools.description: Where one team member works on a date (custom overrides win over the default assignment). Defaults to today. GET /team_members/{id}/working_location.

tools.name: charliehr_get_team_member_working_weeks
tools.description: The working-week segments of one team member (which days are full_day/morning/afternoon, weekly hours, from/to dates), company defaults and custom overrides. Not paginated. GET /team_members/{id}/working_weeks.

tools.name: charliehr_list_working_locations
tools.description: List the active working locations (the catalog). With a date, instead returns where each active team member works on that date. GET /working_locations.

tools.name: charliehr_list_leave_requests
tools.description: List leave requests of the whole company (id, team member, approver, status, request type, start/end date, amount and units, duration, details). Optionally only those in a date window. GET /leave_requests.

tools.name: charliehr_get_leave_request
tools.description: One leave request by id. GET /leave_requests/{id}.

tools.name: charliehr_list_team_member_leave_requests
tools.description: The leave requests of one team member, optionally only those in a date window. GET /team_members/{id}/leave_requests.

tools.name: charliehr_list_leave_allowances
tools.description: The current holiday allowance of every team member: allowance, used and remaining, in days and hours, with the leave period. GET /leave_allowances.

tools.name: charliehr_get_team_member_leave_allowance
tools.description: The current holiday allowance of one team member (allowance, used, remaining, in days and hours, with the period). GET /team_members/{id}/leave_allowance.

tools.name: charliehr_list_allowance_adjustments
tools.description: All holiday allowance adjustments of one team member across every leave period (description, days/hours, carryover flag, creator, period). GET /team_members/{id}/allowance_adjustments.

tools.name: charliehr_list_non_holiday_leave_allowances
tools.description: Days taken and limit for each non-holiday leave type (sick, compassionate...) of one team member. GET /team_members/{id}/non_holiday_leave_allowances.

tools.name: charliehr_list_leave_types
tools.description: The enabled leave types (Holiday, Sick...): id, name, deductible, default, auto-approved, sensitive. GET /leave_types.

tools.name: charliehr_get_leave_type
tools.description: One leave type by id. GET /leave_types/{id}.

tools.name: charliehr_list_company_holidays
tools.description: The company's holidays (bank holidays and closures): name, start/end date, duration, deductible. Optionally only those in a date window. GET /company_holidays.

tools.name: charliehr_list_restricted_dates
tools.description: The dates on which leave is restricted (e.g. a year-end freeze): name, start/end date, duration. Optionally only those in a date window. GET /restricted_dates.

tools.name: charliehr_list_salaries
tools.description: SENSITIVE: the salary records of all team members (job title, pay rate, pay period, frequency, currency, effective date, employment type). Needs API keys with access to salary data. GET /salaries.

tools.name: charliehr_list_team_member_salaries
tools.description: SENSITIVE: the salary history of one team member (job title, pay rate, currency, effective date). GET /team_members/{id}/salaries.

tools.name: charliehr_list_team_member_note_types
tools.description: The custom note types (fields such as Employee No. or Laptop Serial Number) with who may see them. GET /team_member_note_types.

tools.name: charliehr_get_team_member_note_type
tools.description: One note type by id. GET /team_member_note_types/{id}.

tools.name: charliehr_list_team_member_notes
tools.description: The custom notes (label and content) stored on one team member (the content of a note labelled as a National Insurance number, and NI-number-looking text, is redacted). GET /team_members/{id}/notes.

tools.name: charliehr_create_team_member_note
tools.description: WRITE: add a custom note (a value for one note type, e.g. an employee number) to a team member in Charlie. It is created immediately and visible to whoever the note type's permissions allow. Use charliehr_list_team_member_note_types for the note type id. POST /team_members/{id}/notes.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: charliehr_list_offices, charliehr_list_team_members, charliehr_get_team_member · Private data: charliehr_get_company, charliehr_get_team_member, charliehr_list_salaries · Public sink: charliehr_list_offices, charliehr_list_team_members, charliehr_get_team_member, charliehr_create_team_member_note.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: charliehr_list_offices, charliehr_list_team_members, charliehr_get_team_member · Private data: charliehr_get_company, charliehr_get_team_member, charliehr_list_salaries · Public sink: charliehr_list_offices, charliehr_list_team_members, charliehr_get_team_member, charliehr_create_team_member_note

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
